requirements.text: The website shall provide information on computer science degree programs across the seven Oregon University System campuses.
The website shall feature a 'Real People' section with video or audio profiles of CS graduates and professionals.
The website shall include a 'High School Courses' section recommending curricula for students interested in CS.
The website shall provide an internal and external search functionality.
The website shall provide links to professional organizations such as ACM and IEEE.
The website shall implement RSS feeds for current CS information.
The website shall include an 'Ask a Grad or Prof' FAQ section.
The website shall provide information on the benefits of pursuing a CS minor in conjunction with other degrees.
The website design shall be teen-friendly, utilizing bullet points, charts, and images to avoid 'walls of text'.
The website shall be easy to navigate to maintain student attention.
The website shall provide rapid response times comparable to the OUS website to accommodate short student attention spans.
The hosting server must support adequate bandwidth for video streaming.
The website shall adhere to the same copyright and security measures as the OUS site.
The website shall be compatible with IE, Firefox, and Netscape browsers.
The website shall implement tracking to evaluate hits and time spent to inform future design and content changes.
Web design must adhere to CSS and style conventions established in version 1.
